_comment: Homograph battery v2 — GENERALIZATION test on unseen contexts and registers (ads, conversational, news, technical, children's, literary). Sentences are DISJOINT from battery v1 AND from the ft7c training/starved sentences, so PASS here means the model learned the reading, not the sentence.
